props.name: ariaDescribedBy
props.description:
aria-describedby attribute
- Applied to the field note or error note for A11y

props.name: errorNote
props.description:
Error message
- An error field note that displays below the radio input

props.name: fieldId
props.description:
Id attribute
- The ID used for A11y and to associate the label with the input

props.name: fieldNote
props.description:
Field note
- The helper text that displays below the radio input

props.name: hideLabel
props.description:
Hide label?
- If true, hides the label from displaying

props.name: isDisabled
props.description:
Disabled attribute
- Changes the component's treatment to represent a disabled state

props.name: isError
props.description:
Error state
- Changes the component's treatment to represent an error state

props.name: isRequired
props.description:
Required attribute
- Sets the radio to be required for validation

events.name: onRadioChange
events.description: Fired when this radio becomes checked. Detail: `{ checked, name, value }`.

slots.description: The component content that appears next to the radio

slots.name: error
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will display in place of the errorNote property

slots.name: field-note
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will display in place of the fieldNote property
